log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

base_dir.description: Base directory for storing state, PID files, and other runtime data

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the central daemon

host.description: Network address the central daemon binds to for RPC (e.g., management IP)

rpc_port.description: Port number for the central daemon's RPC server

workers.description: Number of worker processes for the central daemon

max_tasks.description: Maximum number of concurrent tasks that can be queued (e.g., zone imports)

enabled.description: Whether the central daemon service is enabled

enable_rpc.description: Enable RPC communication for service state reporting

central_enabled.description: Enable DNS zone management functionality in the central daemon

max_records_per_zone.description: Maximum number of DNS records allowed per zone (to prevent abuse)

max_zones_per_tenant.description: Maximum number of DNS zones a single tenant can own

default_ttl.description: Default TTL (Time To Live) for DNS records (in seconds)

default_refresh.description: Default refresh interval for SOA records (in seconds)

default_retry.description: Default retry interval for SOA records (in seconds)

default_expire.description: Default expire time for SOA records (in seconds)

default_minimum.description: Default minimum TTL for SOA records (in seconds)

ixfr_enabled.description: Enable incremental zone transfers (IXFR) for zone updates

axfr_enabled.description: Enable full zone transfers (AXFR) for zone updates

database.pool_size.description: Number of database connections in the connection pool

database.pool_max_overflow.description: Maximum number of connections beyond pool_size allowed

database.connection_recycle_time.description: Time (in seconds) after which database connections are recycled

keystone.project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name for the service account

keystone.project_name.description: Project name for the Designate service account

keystone.user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name for the service account

keystone.username.description: Username for the Designate service account in Keystone

keystone.password.description: Password for the Designate service account in Keystone

keystone.cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for SSL verification (empty = system default)

keystone.region_name.description: Region name for Keystone (leave empty if not used)

rpc_transport_url.description: Message broker URL for RPC communication

rpc_response_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for waiting on RPC responses

rpc_workers.description: Number of RPC worker threads (typically equals central workers)

endpoints.description: List of RPC endpoint configurations (used for extending central functionality)

name.description: Unique name for the RPC endpoint

enabled.description: Enable or disable this RPC endpoint
